sentences.text_target: Tom wakes up early in the morning when his alarm clock rings.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm weɪks ʌp ˈɜːli ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ wɛn hɪz əˈlɑːm klɒk rɪŋz/
sentences.text_native: Tom se réveille tôt le matin quand son réveil sonne.

sentences.text_target: He opens his eyes and sits up slowly in his bed.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈəʊpənz hɪz aɪz ænd sɪts ʌp ˈsləʊli ɪn hɪz bɛd/
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre les yeux et s'assoit lentement dans son lit.

sentences.text_target: He feels a bit tired because he needs more sleep.
sentences.phonetic: /hi fiːlz ə bɪt ˈtaɪəd bɪˈkɒz hi niːdz mɔː sliːp/
sentences.text_native: Il se sent un peu fatigué car il a besoin de plus de sommeil.

sentences.text_target: Tom takes a deep breath to fill his lungs with fresh air.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm teɪks ə diːp brɛθ tuː fɪl hɪz lʌŋz wɪð frɛʃ eə/
sentences.text_native: Tom prend une grande inspiration pour remplir ses poumons d'air frais.

sentences.text_target: His brain starts to work and thinks about the day.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz breɪn stɑːts tuː wɜːk ænd θɪŋks əˈbaʊt ðə deɪ/
sentences.text_native: Son cerveau commence à fonctionner et pense à la journée.

sentences.text_target: He looks in the bathroom mirror at his face and hair.
sentences.phonetic: /hi lʊks ɪn ðə ˈbɑːθruːm ˈmɪrər æt hɪz feɪs ænd heə/
sentences.text_native: Il se regarde dans le miroir de la salle de bains pour voir son visage et ses cheveux.

sentences.text_target: He uses his toothbrush and clean water to brush his teeth.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈjuːzɪz hɪz ˈtuːθbrʌʃ ænd kliːn ˈwɔːtə tuː brʌʃ hɪz tiːθ/
sentences.text_native: Il utilise sa brosse à dents et de l'eau propre pour se brosser les dents.

sentences.text_target: He washes his hands and face with soap.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈwɒʃɪz hɪz hændz ænd feɪs wɪð səʊp/
sentences.text_native: Il se lave les mains et le visage avec du savon.

sentences.text_target: Then he eats some bread and drinks a cup of coffee for breakfast.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hi iːts sʌm brɛd ænd drɪŋks ə kʌp ɒv ˈkɒfi fɔː ˈbrɛkfəst/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il mange du pain et boit une tasse de café pour le petit-déjeuner.

sentences.text_target: Today is a very busy day with many meetings and calls.
sentences.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ɪz ə ˈvɛri ˈbɪzi deɪ wɪð ˈmɛni ˈmiːtɪŋz ænd kɔːlz/
sentences.text_native: Aujourd'hui est une journée très chargée avec de nombreuses réunions et appels.

sentences.text_target: He checks his schedule on his phone.
sentences.phonetic: /hi tʃɛks hɪz ˈʃɛdjuːl ɒn hɪz fəʊn/
sentences.text_native: Il consulte son emploi du temps sur son téléphone.

sentences.text_target: Tom leaves his home and walks to the office.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm liːvz hɪz həʊm ænd wɔːks tuː ðə ˈɒfɪs/
sentences.text_native: Tom quitte chez lui et se rend au bureau à pied.

sentences.text_target: He moves his legs and bends his knees with every step.
sentences.phonetic: /hi muːvz hɪz lɛɡz ænd bɛndz hɪz niːz wɪð ˈɛvri stɛp/
sentences.text_native: Il avance ses jambes et plie ses genoux à chaque pas.

sentences.text_target: His feet inside his shoes hit the ground.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz fiːt ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz ʃuːz hɪt ðə ɡraʊnd/
sentences.text_native: Ses pieds dans ses chaussures frappent le sol.

sentences.text_target: He arrives at his desk and sits down on the chair.
sentences.phonetic: /hi əˈraɪvz æt hɪz dɛsk ænd sɪts daʊn ɒn ðə tʃeə/
sentences.text_native: Il arrive à son bureau et s'assoit sur sa chaise.

sentences.text_target: He opens his computer and looks at the bright screen.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈəʊpənz hɪz kəmˈpjuːtər ænd lʊks æt ðə braɪt skriːn/
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre son ordinateur et regarde l'écran lumineux.

sentences.text_target: His eyes blink often because the light is strong.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz aɪz blɪŋk ˈɒfən bɪˈkɒz ðə laɪt ɪz strɒŋ/
sentences.text_native: Ses yeux clignent souvent car la luminosité est forte.

sentences.text_target: After two hours of work, his throat feels dry.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftə tuː ˈaʊəz ɒv wɜːk, hɪz θrəʊt fiːlz draɪ/
sentences.text_native: Après deux heures de travail, il a la gorge sèche.

sentences.text_target: He swallows and drinks a glass of fresh water.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈswɒləʊz ænd drɪŋks ə ɡlɑːs ɒv frɛʃ ˈwɔːtə/
sentences.text_native: Il déglutit et boit un verre d'eau fraîche.

sentences.text_target: His stomach makes a small noise because it is time for lunch.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈstʌmək meɪks ə smɔːl nɔɪz bɪˈkɒz ɪt ɪz taɪm fɔː lʌntʃ/
sentences.text_native: Son estomac gargouille un peu car c'est l'heure du déjeuner.

sentences.text_target: He stands up from his desk and stretches his arms.
sentences.phonetic: /hi stændz ʌp frɒm hɪz dɛsk ænd ˈstrɛtʃɪz hɪz ɑːmz/
sentences.text_native: Il se lève de son bureau et s'étire les bras.

sentences.text_target: He moves his shoulders and his back to relax his muscles.
sentences.phonetic: /hi muːvz hɪz ˈʃəʊldərz ænd hɪz bæk tuː rɪˈlæks hɪz ˈmʌslz/
sentences.text_native: Il bouge ses épaules et son dos pour détendre ses muscles.

sentences.text_target: He walks to the kitchen to get some food.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks tuː ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn tuː ɡɛt sʌm fuːd/
sentences.text_native: Il se rend à la cuisine pour se procurer à manger.

sentences.text_target: He uses his fingers to hold a healthy sandwich.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈjuːzɪz hɪz ˈfɪŋɡəz tuː həʊld ə ˈhɛlθi ˈsænwɪdʒ/
sentences.text_native: Il tient un sandwich équilibré entre ses doigts.

sentences.text_target: His heart beats normally while he eats quietly.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz hɑːt biːts ˈnɔːməl-i waɪl hi iːts ˈkwaɪətli/
sentences.text_native: Son cœur bat normalement pendant qu'il mange tranquillement.

sentences.text_target: In the afternoon, he types on his keyboard with both hands.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪn ði ˈɑːftəˈnuːn, hi taɪps ɒn hɪz ˈkiːbɔːd wɪð bəʊθ hændz/
sentences.text_native: Dans l'après-midi, il tape sur son clavier avec ses deux mains.

sentences.text_target: When the day finishes, he closes his office door.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn ðə deɪ ˈfɪnɪʃɪz, hi ˈkləʊzɪz hɪz ˈɒfɪs dɔː/
sentences.text_native: À la fin de la journée, il ferme la porte de son bureau.

sentences.text_target: He steps outside and feels the cool evening air on his skin.
sentences.phonetic: /hi stɛps ˈaʊtsaɪd ænd fiːlz ðə kuːl ˈiːvnɪŋ eə ɒn hɪz skɪn/
sentences.text_native: Il sort à l'extérieur et sent l'air frais du soir sur sa peau.

sentences.text_target: He returns home, washes his face, and prepares for a good night of rest.
sentences.phonetic: /hi rɪˈtɜːnz həʊm, ˈwɒʃɪz hɪz feɪs, ænd prɪˈpeəz fɔː ə ɡʊd naɪt ɒv rɛst/
sentences.text_native: Il rentre chez lui, se lave le visage et se prépare pour une bonne nuit de repos.

sentences.text_target: His body relaxes completely when he finally gets into bed.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈbɒdi rɪˈlæksɪz kəmˈpliːtli wɛn hi ˈfaɪnəli ɡɛts ˈɪntuː bɛd/
sentences.text_native: Son corps se détend complètement lorsqu'il se glisse enfin dans son lit.
